title: Spyglass: Now Officially Available
summary: We are thrilled to announce the official launch of Spyglass, making its powerful capabilities accessible to all users for an enriched experience.

title: Enhanced File Management & Display
summary: Take full command of your content with new editor tools that allow you to effortlessly upload, manage, and customize the visual presentation of all your embedded files.

title: Introducing Our Public Product Roadmap
summary: Our new public roadmap provides full transparency into our past achievements, current progress, and exciting future plans.

title: Dynamic Checkboxes Unleashed
summary: Experience beautifully redesigned checkboxes that are easier to click, seamlessly draggable, and perfectly integrated with our sleek new interface.

title: Seamless Co-editing Experience
summary: We've upgraded your collaboration experience, making it easier and more intuitive to work with others in real-time.

title: Enhanced Shared Item Discovery
summary: Effortlessly discover all shared items relevant to your search, empowering seamless collaboration and connection with your network.

title: Noeko Speaks Your Language
summary: Soon, Noeko will welcome users worldwide with enhanced support for a diverse array of global languages.

title: Noeko: Now Open Source
summary: We're open-sourcing Noeko to empower our community with greater control, direct involvement, and complete transparency in the project's exciting future.

title: Elevate Your Knowledge Map
summary: Discover unparalleled clarity and control within your knowledge base as we introduce dynamic filtering by tags and time, alongside effortless exploration of shared items and connections in your enhanced Constellation view.

title: Unlock Your Knowledge: Advanced Filters and Custom Collections
summary: Effortlessly navigate and curate your knowledge base by applying advanced filters and saving your tailored search results into custom, easily accessible collections.

title: Dynamic Content Linking
summary: Discover new, interactive ways to display and engage with your linked notes, tasks, and sources, creating a more intuitive and organized workspace.

title: Noeko's Public Launch and Flexible Hosting Options
summary: We're launching Noeko with flexible hosting options and new plans to power your projects, whether on your servers or in the cloud.

title: Expanded and Refined Theme Collection
summary: Elevate your visual experience with an expanded and refined collection of themes, featuring vibrant new additions and significant improvements to existing favorites.

title: Smarter, More Accurate Daily Greetings
summary: Enjoy a more personalized and precise welcome as your homepage greeting now perfectly matches the time of day.

title: Effortless Tag Organization
summary: Effortlessly manage and unapply tags from multiple items directly within any tag's list view, providing a faster and more intuitive way to organize your content.

title: Unlock Diverse Content Sources
summary: Seamlessly integrate a wider variety of content, including YouTube videos, websites, and text, to centralize and interact with all your knowledge in one powerful hub.
